newsitem.title: USA: Polo Ralph Lauren files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Polo Ralph Lauren files for IPO.

text.p: Polo Ralph Lauren Corp said on Tuesday it filed for an initial public stock offering.
The company and shareholders will sell shares in the offering, to be led by Goldman Sachs & Co. Merrill Lynch & Co and Morgan Stanley & Co will also underwrite the offering.

Polo Ralph Lauren designs, markets and distributes clothing, accessories, home accessories and fragrances. Its products are sold under brand names including Polo, Polo by Ralph Lauren, Polo Sport, Ralph Lauren, RALPH, Lauren, Polo Jeans Co. and Chaps.
The company has applied to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "RL".
